author: Ethan607050
body:
Username: Ethan607050

Banned for: Hacking

Reason I should be unbanned: Well its been a long time, I didn't know I wasn't allowed on an alt to play the game still until I checked on the forums, but I barely did it. Anyway I believe I should be unbanned because I'm loyal to the server, I don't hack anymore, and simply because its fun to play the games. I'm sorry for hacking I truly do apologize, anyone who has hacked before knows its addicting, but I stopped.  Its been almost a year since I was unable to play on this account, (I basically never played on the other one. only a few times before finding out it wasnt allowed) on this server now I'm not hacking (anymore) and I'm very passionate about PvP and having fun on minecraft. The experience here compared to other servers is unbelievable. No one can beat it. The community is great and the way the server is set up makes one of the best servers to ever live on minecraft. I hope I can get unbanned. If I don't I hope MCZone/Avicus and its legacy will live on.
